title: Credit an exact committed-input PASS without a rerun: register/settle the original run's artifacts instead of forcing a credit-only rerun
outcome: A launcher run that was registered at START with a claim binding and passed on its exact committed input with equal source ids gets exactly one verification record through the existing recover/notify path when its record was not delivered, without rerunning tests. The custody model (credit rests on tracking from START) and the --detach classifier are unchanged.
acceptance: A run registered at START with a claim binding that ended PASS on its exact committed input with equal source ids, but whose verification-record send failed or whose route was held (session gone, connection or store changed) and later became available, is settled exactly once by the existing pending path under the same key, without rerunning tests. Shown by a behavioral test.

A record refused because the claim was recovered under a new fence before the record was sent stays Rejected. Its stored detail, and the launcher summary's existing 'verification: rejected:' line, state the cause ('the claim was recovered under a new fence before the record was sent') and the correction ('keep the claim live until the record lands'), and carry no private text from Engram's message. Shown by a behavioral test.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
